title: Zenodo-22150094: example stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording with one clinically confirmed seizure
description: A stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording from one patient undergoing clinical intracranial monitoring, containing a single clinically confirmed seizure with bilateral tonic-clonic evolution. The recording has 100 sEEG contacts across 12 electrodes plus 2 marker channels, sampled at 256 Hz for about 3.9 hours. Annotations mark the clinical onset and seizure. It is shared in iEEG-BIDS format from a Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: Clinical sEEG recorded as EDF+ at 256 Hz (102 signals: 100 sEEG contacts and 2 marker inputs, 16-bit, physical range ±3200 µV). The original EDF+ file was copied byte-identically into iEEG-BIDS with channels, events and electrodes sidecars derived from its header and annotations; no signal processing was applied. MRI (T1/T2) with implanted electrodes exists in the source record but is not redistributed.
